name: manufacturing-uns
description: Local dev from repo root: npm run stack

scripts.stack: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.stack:demo: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile oee-demo up -d --build
scripts.down: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.simulator:stack: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile oee-demo up -d oee_mqtt_simulator
scripts.simulator:stop: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile oee-demo stop oee_mqtt_simulator
